defs.def: a line or small fold in your skin, especially on your face, that forms as you get older （尤指脸上的）皱纹

ex.s: Such wrinkles will no doubt be ironed out, yet they also point to a fundamental problem.
ex.t: 这些缺陷无疑会被解决，但它们也指向一个根本问题。

ex.s: What does the underlined word “wrinkles” in paragraph 2 refer to?
ex.t: 第二段中划线的词"wrinkles"指的是什么？

defs.def: a small fold that you do not want in a piece of cloth or paper （布或纸上的）皱褶，皱痕

ex.s: We were walking on fine, even sand, not wrinkled, as on a flat shore, which keeps the impression of the waves.
ex.t: 我们走在细而平整的沙地上，不像平坦海岸上那样有波纹——那种沙会保留海浪的痕迹。

ex.s: It has not acquired one permanent wrinkle after all its ripples.
ex.t: 历经无数涟漪，它却没有增添一道永久的皱纹。

ex.s: I handed him the money and received change from his poor wrinkled hand.
ex.t: 我把钱递给他，从他那双可怜的、布满皱纹的手里接过了零钱。

defs.def: to make the skin on your face form into lines or folds; to form lines or folds in this way （使脸上）起皱纹；皱起

ex.s: Years may wrinkle the skin, but to give up enthusiasm wrinkles the soul.
ex.t: 岁月也许会使皮肤起皱，但放弃热情却会使灵魂起皱。

ex.s: But these things contrasted horribly with his yellow eyes, his wrinkled yellow skin and black lips.
ex.t: 但这些东西与他黄色的眼睛、起皱的黄皮肤和后黑的嘴唇形成了可怕的对比。

defs.def: to form raised folds or lines in an untidy way; to make sth do this （使）起皱褶
